warnings: Added 2026-10-23 (op04 resume): this sheet was never extracted on 2026-10-19 although subtask 'schedule' was marked done (only the S-06 column table was). Rows read from the per-type details (no tabular schedule); field names follow house 170 A-20 (opening_type / leaf_material / specification).
The title-block 'แบบแสดง' field is blank; the sheet name is taken from the A-01 index ('A-10 แบบขยายประตูหน้าต่าง').
Marks D2, D5, D7, D8, W4-W6 do not appear on this sheet except D2; the floor plans may use more marks (e.g. 'D8' beside the toilet manhole on A-11) - only what this sheet details is recorded.
Sizes printed with '~' (D1 1.80, D0 3.05/0.40, D9 1.40, D2 6.00) are approximate on the drawing and flagged; 'กระจกสีเทา หนา 5 มม.ซิลิโคนอุดร่องกระจก' is printed run-together and kept verbatim.
